revisions.prompt: Repack this exact original game sprite atlas. Keep all TWENTY original characters and pose designs, but fix their spacing for safe sprite cropping. Output 1024x1536 PNG, true transparent background. Strict FOUR equal columns of 256 px, FIVE equal rows of 307 px. Each separate pose MUST fit entirely inside a maximum 180 px wide by 205 px tall centered box in its own cell. No character, flame, lightning, cloth, weapon, halo or shadow may touch another cell. Four columns idle, walking, windup, strike; same viewpoint and consistency. No text, no decorative border, no contact between cells. This is a functional action game sprite atlas, precise isolated grid is essential.

assets.name: actors-oathwood
assets.prompt: EDIT TARGET: the supplied exact twenty-pose fantasy sprite sheet. ONE CHANGE ONLY: Shrink EVERY complete pose, including weapon trails and all particles, to HALF its current size (50%) around its own cell center. Keep four columns, five rows in the same exact row/column order and same original character identities, designs, colors and pose actions. Make an atlas with tiny isolated miniatures and VERY LARGE empty transparent gutters. Most of the sheet should be empty transparent space. No pose may be wider than 115 pixels or taller than 145 pixels on a 1024x1536 sheet. This includes the entire length of spears, lightning, capes and halberds: shrink each COMPLETE silhouette together. In each 256x307 cell center the tiny pose in the middle, leaving at least 65 pixels empty on left AND right and at least 75 pixels empty on top AND bottom. STRICTLY no weapon tip, particle, cloth, shadow or any other fragment may cross a cell boundary. Do not fill empty space by enlarging the figures. The final sheet must have visible straight fully transparent empty corridors running across the WHOLE width between every row and across the WHOLE height between every column. Do not add outlines or grid marks. Preserve true alpha transparency, no colored background. This precise sprite isolation is required so a game can extract every pose without fragments of its neighbors.
